title: Delta Lake MERGE in PySpark: Upserts, SCD Type 2, and the Traps Interviewers Ask About
author: Karan P
brief: MERGE INTO is the workhorse of almost every Delta Lake pipeline on Azure Databricks. It's also one of...
fact: Interview Q: Lookup vs Get Metadata? A: Lookup returns rows from a dataset (max 5,000 rows or 4 MB); Get Metadata returns properties such as childItems, size, lastModified or exists.
